products.name: AlterContacts
products.tagline: AI client relationship assistant that thinks and does ahead
products.description: AlterContacts is a voice-first AI assistant that helps you remember every client and never miss an important follow-up. Just talk about your meeting, and Alter organizes the details, updates the client's profile, and remembers what you promised. It notices upcoming renewals, personal milestones, and relationships that need attention, then prepares your next message for approval. Built for financial advisors, brokers, and consultants who care about relationships, not CRM data entry.

products.name: Rankhog
products.tagline: Get customers from Reddit on autopilot
products.description: Rankhog finds people on Reddit asking for what you sell. It reads each subreddit's rules, writes a reply that helps, and posts it from your own account at a human pace. Say yes to each reply, or turn on autopilot. No Reddit account? Rankhog warms up a new one, and you own it. Run it from the app, or from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP client. 7 days free.

products.name: AI Context Flow MCP
products.tagline: Memory you control, synced to every agent, tool and team
products.description: Ten AI tools, ten partial memories, all drifting apart, with no record of who changed what. AI Context Flow fixes that with one shared memory over MCP. Save a client brief in Claude, and tomorrow your ChatGPT, Grok Bot and your teammate’s Cursor all work from the same version. Organize memory into buckets by project or client, choose who can access each one, and see every edit in full version history. If an agent overwrites something, roll it back.

products.name: Codemany
products.description: Run GitHub Actions on your own infra. Codemany orchestrates the runners: a fresh VM for each job. 3x faster, and NO per-minute bill. Our CI bill went from $215 in October to $4 so far in November. Free 14 days, no card.

products.name: Glassmail
products.tagline: A fast Mac email app with AI that never leaves your Mac
products.description: Most new email apps charge you every month and send your mail to their servers so their AI can read it. Glassmail doesn't. It's a native Mac app for Gmail, iCloud, Outlook and any IMAP account, and its AI runs on your Mac. Ask "what needs me today?" and get an answer. Type "yes, but next week" and get a reply in your own voice. Clear your inbox one key at a time. There's no mail server and no subscription. You pay once, and it's yours.

products.name: Exa Websets V2
products.tagline: Build custom datasets from the live web, 4x faster
products.description: Websets v2 is Exa’s update to its tool for building custom datasets from live web data. Describe what you want in plain language and get rows with sources and reasoning for each match. Per Exa, v2 finds 20% more matches, runs 4x faster and costs about 2x less than v1. The monthly subscription is gone, usage draws from Exa credits, searches are $5 per 1,000 requests, and API access is open to all users on the usage plan.

products.name: OpenVorld
products.tagline: Give your AI agents a home and a Vorld.
products.description: OpenVorld is an open-source harness for AI agents, with a visible world on top. Every project is a pixel-art village, and every agent has a name, a role and a brain: Claude Code, Codex or any OpenAI-compatible API. You watch the crew work, and they ask before they use a folder, a command or a website. Free, open source and local. No account needed.

products.name: Backspin
products.tagline: Learn to DJ in your browser, on real vinyl decks
products.description: Backspin teaches you to DJ in 21 short lessons that run on real turntables in your browser. It performs each move on the decks while you watch, then you try it and it tells you what to fix. Practice songs are built in, so you need no gear, no music files and no account. Free.

products.name: Doddle
products.tagline: Draw on what your videos for 3D effects
products.description: Doddle is a camera for drawing on the world. Film a few steps, draw in the air or on a wall, and your lines stay where you put them. Pick a 3D pen, watch it draw itself, save a vertical video. Free to start; Pro is $6.99 once.

products.name: Shipyard
products.tagline: MCP for Claude, Cursor and Codex to Automate Integrations
products.description: Built for the vibecoding era, where anyone can build an app in a night and the slow part is everything around it. Shipyard is a local CLI and MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Connect your accounts once, then every new product gets its domain, DNS, hosting, database, email and payments set up automatically in about an hour. Your AI gets a build prompt for the exact stack. Ship more ideas, faster. Your keys never leave your computer.

products.name: Beat Watcher
products.tagline: Fast Apple Watch heart rate alerts you can share with family
products.description: Beat Watcher alerts you on Apple Watch the moment your heart rate goes above or below limits you set with the Digital Crown. Background Mode keeps watching when your wrist is down. Alert Sharing sends your alerts to family or friends you choose, in their own Beat Watcher app, free for them. The optional iPhone app can sound Critical Alerts on silent or Do Not Disturb and keeps an Alert History with notes and CSV export. People use it for pacing with POTS, stress awareness and rest.

products.name: Prompt Puncher
products.description: Prompt Puncher is a free browser fighting game where AI CEOs throw hands. Fight as Elon Musk, Sam Altman, Mark Zuckerberg, and more. No downloads or signups required.

products.name: Smorza
products.tagline: Every Mac app gets its own volume and output
products.description: Smorza is a free, open source menu bar app that gives every Mac app its own volume, mute and output. Put a call in your AirPods and music on your speakers, or turn a loud browser down without touching anything else. No audio driver, macOS 14.4+.

products.name: Hollr
products.tagline: Push-to-talk for your family, on iPhone and Apple Watch
products.description: Hollr is a walkie-talkie for your family. Hold one button, say it, let go. It works on iPhone and Apple Watch, including kids' Family Setup watches with no iPhone. Read a message when you can't listen, or react with a tap. Free for two people.

products.name: Publicit
products.tagline: Omnichannel ad infrastructure for marketers and AI agents
products.description: Publicit is self-serve infrastructure to buy advertising across connected TV, street screens and mobile from one API. Choose audience and budget, upload your creative, and our real-time bidder buys the spaces on every channel, with delivery measured hour by hour. Each space shows its price before you buy. Sign-up is free. Built on OpenRTB, with a native MCP server to run campaigns from Claude or ChatGPT.
